rows.commentary: 0.1: Azmatullah Omarzai starts with a massive in-swinger from middle stump that drifts past Saif Hassan, forcing the keeper to scramble left as the umpire extends his arms for a wide.
0.1: Saif Hassan gets off the mark by toe-ending a full, fading delivery wide of cover for a sharp single.
0.2: Omarzai loses his radar again, spilling another bonus run down the leg side for an easy wide to the left-hander.
0.2: Omarzai finds a subtle nip back into the left-hander, allowing Tanzid Hasan Tamim to gently tuck it into the leg side.
0.3: Tanzid Hasan Tamim cops a thick inside edge on a full delivery aimed at middle, sending it safely wide of mid-on.
0.4: Pushing off the front foot, Tanzid Hasan Tamim blocks a probing good-length ball firmly into the cover region.
0.5: Tanzid Hasan Tamim showcases a crisp front-foot drive wide of mid-off, prompting Rashid to launch into a brilliant sliding stop.
0.6: Charging down the pitch, Saif Hassan miscues a flat-batted stroke straight toward mid-off.
1.1: Ahmadzai mirrors his teammate's erratic start, spraying a wide well past the tramline that leaves Tanzid Hasan Tamim grasping at air.
1.1: Yamin Ahmadzai searches for his radar early to Tanzid Hasan Tamim, straying too far down the leg-side for the umpire's outstretched arms to signal a wide.
1.1: Ahmadzai finds an immediate correction, pinning a good length on off-stump that Tanzid Hasan Tamim firmly drives toward mid-off.
1.2: Yamin Ahmadzai strikes the breakthrough as extra bounce catches the edge of Tanzid Hasan Tamim's bat, safely pouched by Rahmanullah Gurbaz behind the stumps.
1.3: Yamin Ahmadzai rattles Soumya Sarkar's stumps, leaving the batsman scoreless and plundering back-to-back wickets in a blistering start.
10.2: Bilal Sami angles a 137.5ks delivery outside off, and Parvez Hossain Emon drives it cleanly towards cover.
10.3: Bilal Sami digs it back of a length on the body, forcing Parvez Hossain Emon to tuck it neatly to mid-wicket.
10.4: Parvez Hossain Emon leans onto the front foot and drives to the left of covers, inducing a misfield before mid-off swiftly covers the ground.
10.5: Bilal Sami fires in a sharp short delivery that sails well over the batter, drawing an unsuccessful pull shot from Parvez Hossain Emon before the umpire signals wide.
10.5: Parvez Hossain Emon drills it straight back toward the bowler, whose diving right-handed effort in the follow-through misses as the ball ricochets off the stumps at the non-striker's end.
10.6: Parvez drives the full delivery straight to the cover-point fielder, whose misfield allows the duo to hustle through for a single.
11.1: AM Ghazanfar rounds the wicket to dart one onto middle, which Parvez Hossain Emon solidly defends to the on-side.
11.2: AM Ghazanfar tosses it up outside off, and Parvez Hossain Emon drives it firmly back into the bowler's hands on the bounce.
11.3: The ball grips and spins sharply into the left-hander, prompting Parvez Hossain Emon to step back and block it toward cover.
11.4: AM Ghazanfar pitches fuller on middle and leg, allowing Parvez Hossain Emon to drive it smoothly down to long-on.
11.5: AM Ghazanfar offers width outside off, and Saif Hassan shifts to the back foot to execute a late cut toward backward point.
11.6: AM Ghazanfar zips a quicker delivery into the pads, and Saif Hassan tucks it toward deep square leg to retain the strike.
12.1: Bilal Sami hurls down a probing good-length delivery outside off, which Saif Hassan expertly cushions into the off-side with gentle hands.
12.2: Bilal Sami offers width outside off, allowing Saif Hassan to angle the bat face and guide it neatly toward backward point.
12.3: Bilal Sami strays wider once more, and Saif Hassan gladly steers the delivery into the covers to rotate the strike.
12.4: Bilal Sami digs it in short from round the wicket, extracting vicious lift that zips past Parvez Hossain Emon's top edge and safely into the gloves.
12.5: Bilal Sami targets the stumps on a sound length, prompting Parvez Hossain Emon to dead-bat the ball right back down the pitch.
12.6: Bilal Sami tests the ribs with a sharp short ball, catching the high part of Parvez Hossain Emon's bat as the pull shot lobs safely just short of mid-wicket.
25.1: Mohammad Nabi drops it in, turning sharply into Saif Hassan, who works it quietly into the leg side.
25.2: Mohammad Nabi keeps it simple to Saif Hassan, pushed straight down to long-on for a comfortable single.
25.3: Mohammad Nabi gives this one more air, inviting Parvez Hossain Emon forward to smother it firmly towards cover.
25.4: Mohammad Nabi slides it through, tapped along the turf toward long-off as Parvez Hossain Emon rotates the strike with ease.
25.5: Mohammad Nabi fires in a flatter arm-ball, handled cleanly by Saif Hassan who nudges it toward long-on.
25.6: Mohammad Nabi floats it full onto the pads, tucked away expertly by Parvez Hossain Emon for a single behind square.
26.1: Azmatullah Omarzai attacks the stumps on a length, but Parvez Hossain Emon can only push a mistimed shot straight to mid-on.
26.2: Azmatullah Omarzai angles it back of a length outside off, drawing Parvez Hossain Emon into a tentative prod that beats the outside edge completely.
26.3: Azmatullah Omarzai offers width, allowing Parvez Hossain Emon to stand tall and drive past sweeper cover to hustle back comfortably for two runs.
26.4: Azmatullah Omarzai rolls his fingers over an off-cutter, but Parvez Hossain Emon opens the face at the very last second to glide it down to the third man boundary.
26.5: Azmatullah Omarzai locks onto a good length around off, solidly defended back towards the cover fielder by Parvez Hossain Emon.
26.6: Azmatullah Omarzai serves up a half-volley wide of off, driven fluidly across the grass to sweeper cover by Parvez Hossain Emon for one.
27.1: Mohammad Nabi loops it up invitingly outside off, and Parvez Hossain Emon stretches out to stroke it firmly toward cover-point.
27.2: Mohammad Nabi extracts sharp bite and turn away from Parvez Hossain Emon, completely beating the attempted cut as the ball sails over the timber.
27.3: Mohammad Nabi fires this one flatter onto middle and leg, safely tucked away into the on-side by Parvez Hossain Emon.
27.4: Mohammad Nabi angles in wide of the crease and darts it straight at middle, solidly dead-batting it right back down the pitch.
27.5: Mohammad Nabi tosses this one up full on middle, drawing Parvez Hossain Emon forward to drive it out toward long-off for a single as the bowler tumbles in his follow-through.
27.6: Mohammad Nabi loops it up on middle and leg, and Saif Hassan meets it on the front foot to punch a single down to long-on.
28.1: Azmatullah Omarzai offers width outside off, allowing Saif Hassan to flash a cut straight to the fielder at point.
28.2: Azmatullah Omarzai pitches fuller around off-stump, comfortably driven by Saif Hassan into the off-side.
28.3: Azmatullah Omarzai targets a good length outside off, met by Saif Hassan with soft hands in defense.
28.4: Azmatullah Omarzai angles it onto the pads, and Saif Hassan tucks it straight towards the mid-wicket fielder.
1.6: Shoriful Islam offers width, and Ibrahim Zadran leans forward to carve it exquisitely through the off-side before racing hard across the heavy turf for three.
2.1: Taskin Ahmed searches for inward movement from a back of a length, and Ibrahim Zadran quietly pats the delivery down towards mid-on.
2.2: Taskin Ahmed sprays a sharp full ball down the leg side, eluding Emon's full-length dive to concede five extras.
2.2: Taskin Ahmed provides width on a shortish length, allowing Ibrahim Zadran to stand tall and punch past backward point for three runs.
2.3: Taskin Ahmed extracts vicious bounce and away-movement outside off to completely befuddle Rahmanullah Gurbaz.
2.4: Rahmanullah Gurbaz capitalises on width and length by unleashing an authoritative upper cut over backward point all the way to the rope.
2.5: Taskin Ahmed sends down a devastating seamer that creeps through the bat-pad gate of Rahmanullah Gurbaz to flatten the stumps.
2.6: Taskin Ahmed lands one in the corridor, nipping it away sharply as Sediqullah Atal wisely offers no shot.
3.1: Shoriful Islam delivers an angled swinger that Ibrahim Zadran meets firmly, only to pick out the fielder stationed at cover.
3.2: Shoriful Islam pitches full on off stump, inviting Ibrahim Zadran to stroke it effortlessly toward mid-off.
3.3: Shoriful Islam digs it back of a length outside off, watching the ball veer past the tramline for a wide.
3.3: Shoriful Islam generates away-movement off a short length, catching the bottom of Ibrahim Zadran's bat as he tries to force it through the ring.
3.4: Shoriful Islam attacks a hard length on middle and off, drawing a defensive push from Ibrahim Zadran towards the cover region.
3.5: Shoriful Islam unleashes a searing inswinging yorker, forcing Ibrahim Zadran to clear his front leg and somehow squirt it off the toe-end against his pads.
3.6: Shoriful Islam fires in a searing yorker as Ibrahim Zadran jams his bat down in the nick of time to survive a stern examination.
4.1: Taskin Ahmed lands one on a good length well outside off, watching it shape further away while Sediqullah Atal stands tall and offers no stroke.
4.2: Taskin Ahmed hits a length on off that seams away sharply, prompting Sediqullah Atal to lift his bat skyward for a watchful leave.
4.3: Dot ball from Taskin Ahmed to Sediqullah Atal.
13.4: Mustafizur Rahman drops it short on middle and leg, where Rahmat Shah hangs back to punch it straight to mid-on.
13.5: Mustafizur hits a hard length on off, allowing Rahmat to punch it towards mid-off and scamper across for a single.
13.6: Mustafizur fires it back of a length on middle and leg, prompting Ibrahim Zadran to tuck it neatly to mid-wicket.
14.1: Aliss Al Islam drifts a full delivery onto off, which Rahmat flicks straight to short mid-wicket.
14.2: Rahmat dances down the track to meet Aliss's tossed-up delivery outside off, lofting it cleanly over mid-off for four.
14.3: Aliss serves up a full delivery drifting toward leg, and Rahmat sweeps it away toward long leg for a single.
14.4: Aliss pitches it on a length in line with the stumps, and Ibrahim punches it straight down to long-on for a comfortable run.
14.5: Aliss offers a floaty full delivery on off, and Rahmat flicks it away towards long-on to rotate the strike.
14.6: Aliss lands one back of a length on middle that turns in, catching Ibrahim's inside edge onto the pads as he attempts to tuck it across.
15.1: Mustafizur hits a back-of-a-length spot on middle and off, inviting Rahmat to hang back and push it toward the cover region.
15.2: Mustafizur tests the batsman with a hard length on off, met by a back-foot punch from Rahmat directly to extra cover.
15.3: Mustafizur digs in a shortish delivery on middle and leg, which Rahmat mistimes on the pull wide of deep square leg to pick up two runs.
15.4: Mustafizur Rahman drops it back on middle and off, and Rahmat Shah hangs deep to steer it toward backward point.
15.5: Mustafizur tests the shorter length outside off, forcing Rahmat to camp back and punch it cleanly to wide mid-on.
15.6: Mustafizur offers a fuller pitch that Rahmat drives sweetly on the up, past a fumbling Rishad and deep toward the boundary before the chase saves a certain fourth run.
16.1: Aliss Al Islam angles one back of a length into middle that grips and turns away, allowing Rahmat to nudge it safely down to long-on.
16.2: Aliss floats a full delivery onto off stump, and Ibrahim Zadran throws the kitchen sink at it, skewing an inside edge straight to short fine leg.
16.3: Ibrahim Zadran does not score off Aliss Al Islam.
